geography.network: Local in-memory Response; no external request

isolation: Per browser document/iframe. No shared server state or browser storage.
reset: User confirmation then reloads only preview iframe; Escape/cancel keeps current document. No global storage clearing.
refresh: Reconstruct declared review panel from URL; later edits/drafts/receipts/password changes reset. App Preview reauthenticates. No durable backend claim.
secret_scan: No private key, GitHub/OpenAI credential or local user path pattern detected in packaged files; public demo credentials only.
